name: Pillar
description: A concrete support pillar sweating rust. Good to hide behind. Bad to hit.

name: Rubble
description: A heap of broken masonry. You can see over it. You can't walk through it without regret.

name: Crate
description: A shipping crate stenciled PROPERTY OF SOMEONE WHO DIED.

name: Barrel
description: A chemical drum with the label scratched off, which is never a good sign.

name: Pipe Cluster
description: A knot of pipes coming up through the floor and going nowhere in particular.

name: Dead Boiler
description: A boiler the size of a hatchback. Cold. Mostly.

name: Lockers
description: A bank of maintenance lockers. One of them is humming.

name: Shopping Cart
description: An overturned shopping cart. It got further from the store than you did.

name: Sludge
description: Ankle-deep sump water with a skin on it. Slows you down. Doesn't otherwise judge.

name: Steam Vent
description: A floor vent coughing scalding steam on a schedule only it knows.

name: Live Wire
description: A severed cable lying in a puddle, which is the worst place for either of them.

name: Gas Leak
description: A cracked line hissing something green. Breathe through your mouth. Actually, don't.

name: Rust Spikes
description: A grate with its bolts sheared off, all points up. Tetanus as a design language.

name: Caltrops
description: Jacks, nails and spite scattered across the floor. Whoever steps here will remember it.

name: Tacks
description: A box of thumbtacks, all of them face up. Office supplies, weaponized.

name: Barbed Wire
description: A coil of barbed wire. It doesn't want you to pass. It's very clear about it.

name: Broken Glass
description: Bottle glass, ground fine by a thousand feet. Some of them were bare.

name: Marbles
description: Ball bearings and marbles rolling around underfoot. Great for cartoons. Bad for ankles.

name: Oil Slick
description: A slick of something that used to be lotion, or motor oil, or both.

name: Glue
description: A puddle of industrial superglue. Step in it once. Only once, because you'll be there a while.

name: Fire
description: Burning fuel spreading across the floor. It is very much on fire.

name: Smoke
description: A cloud of greasy smoke. Nobody sees through it. Nobody aims through it.

name: Trip Wire
description: A wire strung ankle-high across the floor. Invisible, if you're the one walking.
